suggestions.description: Promote the independent browser checks from this review into permanent regression tests. The existing motion unit test validates the integration helper, but its zero-distance assertion does not exercise the reset button or the apparatus drawing integration. Add browser assertions for forward road phase during positive-velocity deceleration, phase preservation on pause, phase zero on reset, clockwise positive beam tilt, and all three gain controls affecting the command. These behaviors passed the independent browser checks in this review.

summary: PASS: independently inspected the current staged worktree, especially assets/app.js, assets/motion.js, assets/physics.js and their tests; no functional or security blockers found. Fresh npm test execution passed all 18 tests; fresh Playwright execution against http://127.0.0.1:8765/simulators/ passed all 7 browser tests. Additional inline headless Chromium checks instrumented actual canvas operations: after changing the cruise target to zero, positive speed decreased from 18.719 to 14.190 m/s while 32 rendered road phases remained continuous and forward; pause preserved phase and the reset button restored phase to zero. app.js integrates sceneDistance once per fixed physics step using previous/current velocity and explicitly clears it on reset, so the prior elapsed-time-times-current-velocity reversal is corrected in the actual drawing path, not merely in a standalone helper. Positive beam input produced a clockwise canvas rotation of 0.22842249849709695 rad, consistent with positive/rightward downhill acceleration; its displayed input was 0.228. In every live experiment, setting Kp/Ki/Kd to zero through their actual DOM input handlers changed the command to zero on subsequent steps, and reset retained those settings. Model inspection and passing tests cover derivative-on-measurement feedback, exact held-input plant integration, saturation/conditional antiwindup, clearing integral bias when Ki is disabled, bounded beam angle, latched rail failure and deterministic reset. Catalog source and browser assertions confirm 15 projects, exactly 3 launchable experiments and 12 explicitly planned entries without launch links; Korean teaching controls and simplified-model disclosures are present. No login, download, result-save or tracking implementation was found. Static review found no user-controlled HTML insertion, eval, credential literals or application data-exfiltration path; catalog HTML interpolates repository-owned constants, not search input. Both staged and unstaged git diff whitespace checks passed. Review scope is local behavior, not deployed-site or external-source-link availability. Only docs/review.json was written in the repository by this reviewer; no implementation changes or commits were made.
